commands.title: Create a table
commands.description: Creates a table from a title and optionally its fields (each with a type and options) and views; without fields it gets a primary text field Title, without views a grid view All. Answers the table with its ids.

name.description: The table's internal name, the key of its values when a field: lowercase ASCII letters, digits and `_`, starting with a letter and not ending with `_` (`^[a-z](?:[a-z0-9_]*[a-z0-9])?$`), unique among the document's tables. An explicit name is kept as given; one not in that form, or already taken (also by an earlier field of the same call), is refused with invalid_params. Without one it is derived from the title: letters and digits kept and lowercased, every other run of characters made one `_`, `_` trimmed, `f_` put before a leading digit, `field` when nothing is left (a title in Chinese, say, for a table too), then `_2`, `_3`, ... when taken.

The field's internal name, the key of its values when a field: lowercase ASCII letters, digits and `_`, starting with a letter and not ending with `_` (`^[a-z](?:[a-z0-9_]*[a-z0-9])?$`), unique among the table's fields. An explicit name is kept as given; one not in that form, or already taken (also by an earlier field of the same call), is refused with invalid_params. Without one it is derived from the title: letters and digits kept and lowercased, every other run of characters made one `_`, `_` trimmed, `f_` put before a leading digit, `field` when nothing is left (a title in Chinese, say, for a table too), then `_2`, `_3`, ... when taken.

action.description: The AI action (summarize, translate, extract, improve, customize, classify, text_generation, image_generation, image_customization); when given, it must be the field's own.

config.description: Overrides of the field's AI configuration for this run.

record_ids.description: The records to run on, instead of recordId.

limit.description: How many records to prepare at most.

outputSchema.description: The request's own answer is in `result`, beside `change`: what the call changed in the document (null when nothing changed). A failed call answers `error` instead (A18).

result.description: The model requests of the run, for the host to generate and answer with table.ai.apply.

items.description: A part: {type: text, text} or {type: image, mime, hash?, url?}.

options.description: An image request's count, size, width, height, quality and useCase.

items.description: A record left out of a batch.

model.description: The model the field asks for, when it names one.

field.

schema.description: Tables whose fields were added, removed, updated, or reordered.

views.description:

changed.

dashboards.description: A dashboard, or the base's list of them, changed.

origin.description: Who wrote it: kind:principal, or a system origin's label.

change.description: What the call changed, or null.

commands.title: Read a table's or a view's records
commands.description: Reads the records of one table, or of one view (only those its filter keeps, in its order), with their ids and values under the field names, a page at a time; changes nothing.

tableId.description: The table whose records to list, in order (a table's id, as inspect and table.tables.list answer it).

viewId.description: Instead of tableId: the view whose records to list, only those its filter keeps, in its order (a view's id, as inspect and table.views.list answer it).

limit.description: How many records to list, 1 to 200; default 50.

cursor.description: Where to go on: the cursor in a previous answer's next (the number of records before the page, counted from 0, as a string); default the first record.

outputSchema.description: The request's own answer is in `result`, beside `change`: what the call changed in the document (null when nothing changed). A failed call answers `error` instead (A18).

viewId.description: The view's id, when a view was read.

items.description: A field's name: the key of its values in table.records.create and table.records.update.

tool_id.description: The stable UUID accepted by recordId and used by receipts and conflicts.

items.description: Its value in the column at the same position; null when empty. A link's records are {id, display}, by record id; text longer than 200 characters is cut and ends in an ellipsis.

from.description: The first listed record's position, counted from 1.

to.description: The last listed record's position, counted from 1.

total.description: How many records the table has, or the view shows.

next.description: The step that lists the records after these; absent after the last.

params.description: Its params: the same tableId or viewId, and the cursor to go on from.

commands.title: Render a preview image
commands.description: Draws the table, a view, some of its rows, a field, one record's cell or a dashboard as the editor shows them, as a PNG at a scale up to 2, such as the target a diagnostic names; changes nothing.

target.description: What to draw: a table or a view by id (table, view), or a diagnostic's target as the check answered it. table is a table's id (its first view), view a view's id (the records it shows, filtered and in its order). path is tables/<id> (the table as the editor opens it), tables/<id>/views/<id> (a view, the records it shows), tables/<id>/fields/<id>, tables/<id>/records/<id> or tables/<id>/records/<id>/fields/<id> (every field and record of the table, that one outlined and the picture framed around it), or dashboards/<id>; sheet, a table's title, when there is no path. rows [from, to] draws only the records at those positions of the table or view, counted from 1 as the grid numbers them. Default: the first table's first view, whatever the editor shows.

table.description: A table's id, as table_inspect lists it: the table as its first view shows it.

view.description: A view's id, as table_inspect lists it: the records it shows, in its order.

path.description: tables/<id>[/views/<id> | /fields/<id> | /records/<id>[/fields/<id>]] or dashboards/<id>, with the ids table_inspect answers.

sheet.description: A table's title (a diagnostic gives it beside path).

rows.description: [from, to]: the records at these positions, counted from 1, both included.

slide.description: Without target: the table at this position among the tables, counted from 0 (a host's part preview).

scale.description: Device pixels per document pixel, above 0 and up to 2; default 1.

maxSize.description: The longest side in pixels, 1 to 4096; default 4096.

scale.description: The scale it was drawn at.

tableId.description: The table drawn; null for a dashboard.

viewId.description: The view drawn; null without one.

error.description: Why the call failed (A18); the file is as it was.

commands.description: Lists the file's tables and dashboards as its outline, each with its id, its title, what it is and the place the editor opens the file at; changes nothing.

items.description: The file's tables, then its dashboards, in the document's order.

view.description: The place, as the editor opens the file at it: { path }.

error.description: Why the call failed (A18); the file is as it was.

tableId.description: The table to export; default the first table.
